title: Puzzle Packs
swipeToRip: Swipe across the pack to rip it
pack.basic.desc: Free. Cards from completed series (they turn into coins) and sometimes from the current one.
pack.series.desc: Cards from the current series only, with better odds for missing pieces.
pack.premium.desc: More cards from the current series and 5× rare chance.
toastAutoBody: It opens packs by itself, even while the game is closed.
end.title: Collection complete!
end.body: You completed all {0} series. Thanks for playing!
up.cards.desc: +1 card in every pack, per level.
up.pity.desc: Pity guarantees a new piece 1 pack sooner, per level.
up.auto.desc: The auto-opener gets 12% faster per level. Needs Series 1 complete.
up.subscription.desc: The auto-opener buys and opens Series Packs when you have the coins. Needs Series 2 complete.
up.value2.desc: Duplicates are worth +25% per level. Needs Series 2 complete.
up.luck2.desc: Rare chance +25% per level. Needs Series 2 complete.
up.auto2.desc: The auto-opener gets 15% faster per level. Needs Series 3 complete.
up.value3.desc: Duplicates are worth +30% per level. Needs Series 4 complete.
up.luck3.desc: Rare chance +30% per level. Needs Series 4 complete.
up.cards3.desc: +1 card in every pack. Needs Series 5 complete.
tut.rip: Welcome! Drag your finger (or mouse) across the pack to rip it open. A tap opens it too.
tut.flip: Every card is a puzzle piece. They flip on their own, but you can tap to flip them faster.
tut.board: New pieces snap into the board. Collect them all to complete the series picture.
tut.dupes: Duplicate pieces turn into coins, and rares are worth more. Spend coins in the shop and on upgrades.
tut.shop: You can buy a Series Pack now. It only has cards from the current series, with better odds for the pieces you're missing.
tut.upgrades: You have enough coins for an upgrade. Tap Upgrades.
tut.tree: Tap a glowing node to buy it. Hover over it to see what it does, and drag the background to move the tree.
tut.auto: Series complete! The auto-opener is unlocked: it opens packs by itself, even while the game is closed. Upgrades make it faster.
tut.album: Your first picture is complete. Take a look in the Album.
tut.albumView: Every series and its progress lives here. Tap View image to see the whole illustration.
